sampling.method: chronological fixed stride; no randomisation, no peeking

label_definition: Labels are computed only after the evaluation: for a LONG candidate the bar is a hit when close at t+horizon is above close at t, and a miss when it is below; SHORT is the mirror. Forward return is (close[t+horizon]-close[t])/close[t]*100 in the candidate's direction. Max favourable/adverse excursion measures the high/low path in ATR units and is a measurement only, not an entry/stop rule. These are algorithmic labels, not reviewed trades.

missed_opportunities.note: A material move after WAIT/NO_TRADE is a missed opportunity only in hindsight; it is not counted as an error because the strategy intentionally declines unclear setups.

gate.reason: No independent human review of the 60 exported cases has been performed. The gate must not be reported as passed on algorithmic labels alone.

case_selection.method: Deterministic stratified sample: every candidate (capped at the limit), then evenly spaced WAIT decisions, then evenly spaced NO_TRADE decisions in chronological order.

limitations: Single synthetic/local dataset; not a live-trading sample.
Algorithmic labels only; no independent review.
No fees, funding, slippage or order-fill simulation.
Fixed-stride sampling keeps runtime bounded but still overlaps forward windows.
The strategy emits no entry, stop or target, so no trade PnL is claimed.
